faqs.q: How do I install a VYRO app?
faqs.a: Get it from our Telegram channel, open the APK file, allow “install from this source” if Android asks, then tap Install.
Yes — all VYRO apps are free to use.
Every app is made by VYRO, works on your own device, and most work fully offline. The permissions an app needs are listed on its download post.

faqs.q: How do I update an app?
faqs.a: Download the latest version from the Telegram channel and install it over the old one — your data stays.

faqs.q: What is the VYRO Pro Pack?
faqs.a: One pack that unlocks premium extras across VYRO apps — see the Pro Packs page for details.
